Those are just intermediate scratch files (raw log dumps + a duplicate of `redispatched_ids.json`) — intentionally left out of the PR. Everything needed is committed and pushed.

## Summary

Triaged all 45 real stale tasks (29 `credit_accountant_rejected` + 16 `openrouter_balance_exhausted`, live-derived from the audit JSON + task checkpoint history, deduplicated into 21 unique objectives):

- **6 objectives (10 rows) ALREADY_DONE_ELSEWHERE** — e.g. prompt-cache metrics (PR #423), CRM Wave 1 schema + Contacts route (PRs #507–510), the autonomous gap-queue (alive, just owner-paused)
- **12 objectives (30 rows) GENUINELY_STILL_OPEN** — e.g. delegation-expiry not wired into checkpoints, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY still present, GstRt still hardcoded to 0
- **3 objectives (5 rows) UNCLEAR_NEEDS_OWNER_DECISION** — evidence was genuinely mixed, left for owner call rather than guessed

Redispatched all 12 genuinely-open objectives as fresh tasks (one each, not per duplicate retry) using their real original prompts — all 12 passed the spend gate this time and are running, confirming the 2026-07-20 resource exhaustion has cleared.

Report: `ai-os/TIER3_RELEVANCE_TRIAGE_REPORT_2026-07-26.md`. PR (not merged): https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/97
